compare-specific-page-range-pdf.title: Compare Specific Page Range of Two PDFs
compare-specific-page-range-pdf.description: Loads two PDF documents, defines a page range, compares the selected pages using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API, and reports the number of differences per page.

compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.title: Compare PDF Documents Page by Page and Generate Diff PDF
compare-pdf-documents-page-by-page-diff.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF files page by page using Aspose.Pdf's default ComparisonOptions and save the resulting diff PDF.

compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.title: Compare Selected PDF Pages Side‑by‑Side
compare-selected-pdf-pages-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates how to compare specific pages of two PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's side‑by‑side visual comparer and retrieve textual differences.

exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Areas from PDF Comparison
exclude-areas-from-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to define rectangular regions to exclude from each PDF and perform a side‑by‑side comparison using Aspose.Pdf.

exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Annotations from PDF Comparison
exclude-annotations-from-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates collecting annotation bounding rectangles from two PDFs and configuring SideBySideComparisonOptions to exclude those areas during a side‑by‑side comparison.

exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.title: Exclude Footer Areas in PDF Comparison
exclude-footer-areas-in-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to define rectangular exclude areas to omit footers when performing a side‑by‑side PDF comparison using Aspose.Pdf.

compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.title: Compare Two PDFs Using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison
compare-two-pdfs-aspdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents with Aspose.Pdf, generating a result PDF that highlights differences. The example notes that case‑insensitive text comparison is not directly supported in the current API.

set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.title: Set Custom Image Similarity Tolerance for PDF Comparison
set-custom-image-similarity-tolerance-pd.description: Demonstrates how to configure a custom tolerance percentage for image differences when comparing two PDFs using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer and generate diff images.

compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.title: Compare PDFs Including Form Field Values
compare-pdfs-with-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents, including form field values, and generate both a JSON diff report and a side‑by‑side visual PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison.

compare-pdfs-ignore-signature-fields.title: Compare PDFs While Ignoring Signature Fields
compare-pdfs-ignore-signature-fields.description: Loads two signed PDFs, extracts the rectangles of all signature fields, excludes those areas from comparison, and generates a visual diff PDF.

compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.title: Compare PDFs with Different Page Sizes
compare-pdfs-different-page-sizes.description: Shows how to align the page dimensions of two PDFs and use GraphicalPdfComparer to compare them, handling size mismatches and customizing comparison settings.

compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.title: Compare PDFs Textually Ignoring Compression Differences
compare-pdf-text-ignoring-compression.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF files that have identical content but different compression settings using Aspose.Pdf's flat text comparison, ensuring compression does not affect the diff results.

compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.title: Compare PDFs with Unicode Text and Detect Differences
compare-pdfs-unicode-text-differences.description: Creates English and Russian PDFs, then uses Aspose.Pdf's comparison API to detect Unicode text differences and generate a visual diff PDF.

compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.title: Compare PDFs and Detect Font Differences
compare-pdfs-detect-font-differences.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF files using Aspose.Pdf and report font changes as separate diff operations.

compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.title: Compare Encrypted PDFs Side‑by‑Side with Passwords
compare-encrypted-pdfs-side-by-side.description: Demonstrates loading two password‑protected PDF files and performing a side‑by‑side visual comparison using Aspose.Pdf, saving the result as a new PDF.

in-memory-pdf-comparison-diff.title: In-Memory PDF Comparison with Diff Output
in-memory-pdf-comparison-diff.description: Demonstrates loading two PDFs from memory streams, comparing them page‑by‑page using Aspose's GraphicalPdfComparer, and returning the visual diff as a new PDF in a memory stream.

generate-visual-diff-pdf.title: Generate Visual Diff PDF Using GraphicalPdfComparer
generate-visual-diff-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents and create a visual diff PDF with Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer.

get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.title: Get Image Differences Between PDF Pages
get-image-differences-between-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer, retrieve image differences, and save the source and destination images.

generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.title: Generate a Diff PDF by Comparing Two PDFs
generate-diff-pdf-by-comparing-two-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf to compare two PDF documents and create a highlighted diff PDF saved to a specified folder.

generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.title: Generate Diff PDF with Highlighted Text Changes and Verify Default Colors
generate-diff-pdf-highlighted-text-chang.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF pages, generate a diff PDF with highlighted insertions/deletions, and validate that the highlight color matches the default red setting.

compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.title: Compare PDFs and Generate JSON Diff Report
compare-pdfs-generate-json-diff-report.description: The example loads two PDF files, extracts their text page by page using Aspose.Pdf, identifies added, removed or modified pages, creates DiffOperation objects, and serializes the differences to a JSON report.

replace-text-using-diffoperation.title: Replace Text in PDF Using DiffOperation Comparison
replace-text-using-diffoperation.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF pages, reconstruct the original text from the first PDF using DiffOperation objects, and replace the text content of the second PDF page with the reconstructed text.

compare-pdfs-log-differences.title: Compare PDFs and Log Differences by Page
compare-pdfs-log-differences.description: Shows how to compare two PDF documents page‑by‑page with Aspose.Pdf and write an audit log that records each diff operation type together with its page number.

compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.title: Compare Two PDFs and Generate a Visual Diff
compare-two-pdfs-visual-diff.description: Demonstrates how to compare two PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf, generate a list of differences, and create a result PDF that visually highlights those differences.

preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.title: Copy Original PDF Metadata to Diff PDF
preserve-original-metadata-in-diff-pdf.description: The example compares two PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Comparison and then copies all document metadata from the original PDF to the generated diff PDF, ensuring the diff retains the original information.

multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.title: Multi-Threaded PDF Comparison with Aspose.Pdf
multi-threaded-pdf-comparison.description: Demonstrates how to compare multiple pairs of PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf's side‑by‑side comparer together with .NET tasks.

batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.title: Batch PDF Comparison with Parallel Processing
batch-pdf-comparison-parallel.description: Demonstrates how to compare a large set of PDFs against a reference file using Aspose.Pdf's comparison API while limiting concurrency with SemaphoreSlim to control memory usage.

generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.title: Generate PDF Diff Images and Zip Them
generate-pdf-diff-images-zip.description: Shows how to compare two PDFs with Aspose.Pdf's GraphicalPdfComparer, export the visual differences as PNG images, and package the resulting images into a ZIP archive.
